title: The Paperwork Is the Miracle
alt: Four panels in a teal office with a night window. Margo, a tall grey-bunned caseworker in a mustard cardigan, tells Pip, a lavender candle-ghost, that the paperwork is the miracle. Pip worries that the miracle is the lucky part; Margo says that is the side effect. Pip stamps a form at a desk, flame tall. Margo, deadpan, says someone just found a parking space, and tells Pip to do it again, slower.
hover: Pip's first stamp. Margo's first compliment.
transcript: Panel 1 – MARGO: Rule one. The paperwork is the miracle.
Panel 2 – PIP: I thought the miracle was the part where somebody gets lucky.
Panel 2 – MARGO: That's the side effect.
Panel 4 – MARGO: Someone just found a parking space. Good. Now do it again, slower.
note: Day one. Nobody has said 'welcome' yet; Margo's version is the second rule.
